title: Map
---

```{python}
from bike_routes.map_views import build_map
from bike_routes.repositories import RouteSnapshotRepository

map_object = build_map(RouteSnapshotRepository().load())
# a fixed height, rather than folium's default aspect ratio, which is too short on narrow screens
map_object.get_root().height = 600
map_object
```
